message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a "NapMat." I recall that CBP classified similar nap mats as quilted bedding of man-made fibers. The candidate headings are 9404.90 (articles of bedding, stuffed, other) and 6307.90 (other made-up articles).

The mat is a stuffed sleep mat with an integrated pillowcase and a blanket. Heading 9404 covers "mattress supports; articles of bedding and similar furnishing, fitted with springs or stuffed or internally fitted with any material." A stuffed sleep mat fits there. Within 9404.90, the subheadings are 9404.90.10 (pillows, cushions and similar furnishings) and 9404.90.20 (other: quilts, comforters, etc.), with the 9404.90.85 line covering other (9404.90.8522 for other of cotton and 9404.90.8580 for other).

By my memory of the subheading structure:
- 9404.90.10: Pillows, cushions and similar furnishings
- 9404.90.20: Other, of cotton
- 9404.90.80: Other, other (9404.90.8010 comforters/quilts, 9404.90.8020 other)

The "other" line appears to be 9404.90.8000, with statistical suffixes 9404.90.8505 and 9404.90.9505 (the latter for other). I am not certain of these.

Choosing between them, the mat is a sleeping bag-like article of man-made fiber stuffing. Sleeping bags fall under 9404.30. This one is not a bag, so I'll go with 9404.90.9505, the "other, other" line for non-cotton articles. I recall 9404.90.85 as "other: other: of cotton" and 9404.90.95 as "other: other," so I'm using 9404.90.9570 as a plausible statistical suffix.

{"hts_code": "9404.90.9570", "reason": "The polyester-filled quilted sleep mat with an attached blanket and pillow is stuffed bedding of man-made fibers, classified in heading 9404 as other articles of bedding, not of cotton."}
